Archival Dispatch: 18 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Pennsylvania Keystone of Democracy, Backstage Wife, and The Son of Porthos

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: Pennsylvania Keystone of Democracy, Valley Forge, Stephen Foster, Backstage Wife, Mary Noble, Frank Hummert, Anne Hummert, Claire Niesen, The Son of Porthos, Alexandre Dumas, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 66 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 66 recovers and dates 18 classic radio broadcasts spanning educational historical docudramas, Golden Age daytime serial melodramas, and swashbuckling literary adventure serials: 6 founding episodes of the celebrated state historical series Pennsylvania: Keystone of Democracy (1941, produced by the Pennsylvania Historical Commission, covering George Washington at Valley Forge, the origins of the American steel industry, Stephen Foster, and the Pennsylvania long rifle), 6 consecutive serialized episodes of Frank and Anne Hummert's legendary NBC daytime soap opera Backstage Wife (May 1944, starring Claire Niesen as Mary Noble navigating the backstage murder of Oliver Wilson), and 6 serialized chapters of the 1939 syndicated adventure serial The Son of Porthos (adapting Alexandre Dumas' swashbuckling sequel to The Three Musketeers).
